answer: Stop sybils with a knoll wander: an agent stakes a bond for one knoll. Each cycle it wanders a set route on the knoll; at the nadir checkpoint verifiers check its trail, voiding a trail copied, broken, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 knolls and trails at 16x each: each trail fits one knoll, one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents wander once past the nadir checkpoint and keep rights.
